title: HIT smart farm · Satellite & drone survey
description: Eight fixed simulation tools: acquire, classify, post-process and present satellite imagery; survey, build an orthomosaic, identify fields and present drone results.

roi.label: Rice survey area
roi.selection: Rice-dense survey window with mixed edge pixels; preserves the drone orthomosaic aspect ratio

surfaceHints.method: Illustrative local RGB brightness/green/gray heuristics; not a building or road classification product.
surfaceHints.coordinates: Satellite-normalized image XY; rectangle x/y denote centers.

orthomosaicMetadata.placement: Simulated anchored survey footprint, not the original capture location

identify_crop_type.caption: Historical classification log; the current demo statistics come from the clipped local raster.

post_process_results.caption: Historical post-processing log from the prepared source workflow.

raw_images_to_visible_orthomosaic.caption: Prepared orthomosaic; its placement in the satellite farm is simulated.

identify_field_distribution.caption: Historical source log. Its old mock area constants differ from the re-anchored areas shown in this demo.

droneMetrics.area_method: WGS84 geodesic area after simulated placement

farmArea.description: The entire AOI, including fields, buildings, roads and other land cover.

satelliteRiceArea.formula: Sum of WGS84 areas of the 2189 class-1 pixels / 10000
satelliteRiceArea.description: Rice pixels across the entire clipped farm; not the drone survey area.

surveyFootprint.formula: WGS84 area of the selected ROI rectangle / 10000
surveyFootprint.description: The whole survey rectangle, including mixed edge classes and the drone image background. This is not rice area.

droneRiceArea.source: rice_distribution.shp placed inside the selected ROI
droneRiceArea.formula: WGS84 area of the re-anchored rice polygons / 10000
droneRiceArea.description: Prepared UAV rice shapes are rescaled to the survey footprint; this is a simulated demonstration measurement, not the original source-area constant.

droneLodgingArea.source: rice_lodging_distribution.shp placed using the same transform
droneLodgingArea.formula: WGS84 area of the re-anchored lodging polygons
droneLodgingArea.description: Lodged subset within the re-anchored UAV rice shapes.

lodgingRate.source: Re-anchored lodging and rice polygon areas
lodgingRate.description: Denominator is drone rice area, not the entire ROI footprint or satellite rice area.

provenance.registration: Simulated anchored survey: the UAV image and vectors are intentionally placed into a rice-dense window of the satellite classification; mixed class pixels are retained.
provenance.coordinates: All scene XY use satellite image normalized coordinates: upper left [0,0], lower right [1,1].
provenance.statistics: Farm, crop and anchored UAV areas are calculated on the WGS84 ellipsoid; raster pixel areas and polygon boundaries may differ slightly.
